Rejas — Madrid, Spain

Higher caution advised day Higher caution advised night

In detail

Rejas is the site of the well-documented 'hotel okupa de Rejas', a former apart-hotel complex that press describes as having been the scene of 'numerous criminal episodes' for years; an August 2026 police operation dismantled a criminal network of squatters who had been robbing VTC/rideshare drivers, and an October 2025 report described a Latvian organised-crime figure killed in a settling-of-scores in the same area, which investigators called strategically valuable to criminal networks. Narcopisos with reinforced armoured doors have also been raided in the district in connection with this zone. Sources checked: Antena3, 6 Aug 2026; ABC, 5 Aug 2026; La Razon, 10 Oct 2025 (Latvian mobster killed); El Mundo, 5 Sept 2025 (narcopiso raid, armoured doors).
